<TITLE>EX-3.1</TITLE>

 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE" STYLE="line-height:Normal">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 3.1 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>CERTIFICATE OF AMENDMENT OF </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>THE CERTIFICATE OF INCORPORATION </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>OF </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ENVIRI II CORPORATION
</B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">(a Delaware corporation) </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">Pursuant to &#167;242 of the General Corporation Law </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">of the State of Delaware </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>Dated
as of May&nbsp;29, 2026 </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Enviri II Corporation, a corporation duly organized and existing under the General Corporation Law of the
State of Delaware, does hereby certify as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>FIRST</B>: The name of the corporation is Enviri II Corporation (the
&#8220;<U>Corporation</U>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>SECOND</B>: The board of directors of the Corporation (the &#8220;<U>Board</U>&#8221;) has duly
adopted a resolution setting forth an amendment to the Corporation&#8217;s certificate of incorporation, as amended (the &#8220;<U>Certificate of Incorporation</U>&#8221;) and declared its advisability. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>THIRD</B>: The sole stockholder of the Corporation has duly approved such amendment in accordance with Sections 228 and 242 of the DGCL.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>FOURTH</B>: That Article FOURTH of the Certificate of Incorporation is amended to read in its entirety as follows: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;The total number of shares of stock which the Corporation is authorized to issue is one hundred million (100,000,000) shares of common
stock, par value $0.00001 per share (the &#8220;<U>Common Stock</U>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Upon this Amendment to the Certificate of Incorporation
becoming effective pursuant to the General Corporation Law of Delaware (the &#8220;<U>Effective Time</U>&#8221;), every 1.0 share of the Corporation&#8217;s Common Stock issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time, shall,
automatically and without any action on the part of the respective holders thereof, be converted into 28,103.75 validly issued, fully paid and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-assessable</FONT> shares of Common Stock (the &#8220;<U>Stock
Split</U>&#8221;). The par value of each share of Common Stock shall not be adjusted in connection with the Stock Split.&#8221; </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Corporation has caused this Certificate of Amendment of the
Certificate of Incorporation to be executed and acknowledged by its duly authorized officer this 29<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">th</SUP> day of May, 2026. </P>
